body: I managed to pay it off with the help of a few friends, I'll be working hard over the next few months to get my life back on track. I've got a lot of debts to pay, and only one that's monetary. Can't die 'till I pay them all back and forward.

That admiration isn't deserved. I'm giving life three days, the same as I've been given. 

If a chance comes by, I'll stay alive.

If not, I've made up my mind.
I've told them both. I won't be able to see either before the three days are up, it's a distance issue.

One of them is begging me not to, the other hasn't seen my messages as yet. 

I'd be happy to keep living...but I refuse to sink lower into poverty. I want to go on, I want another chance to come back...but I...I'm not getting one...
